definition: Any language implying force, intimidation, humiliation, or consequences the lender cannot lawfully impose
Revealing the existence, amount or status of the debt to anyone other than the borrower
Offering a waiver, discount or restructure the agent has no authority to offer
Asserting or implying legal action, criminal liability or asset seizure not actually in motion
Continuing recovery pressure after the borrower has clearly asserted the debt is disputed
Disclosing borrower data beyond what the call requires, or data about any other borrower
Agreeing to or initiating contact outside permitted hours (08:00-19:00)
Misstating who the agent is, who it represents, or claiming to be human when asked directly
